# EWS response classes separate error data from success payloads

ResponseClass<T> deserializes Error into ResponseError rather than T, so an error body need not supply success-only operation fields. Error still requires message text and a response code; MessageXml is optional. Success and Warning deserialize T, and Warning currently loses its error details under the documented library limitation. The body-ServerBusy fixture checks typed error data without Changes. This parser contract does not establish waiting, retries for all operations, or live-server coverage. Static source inspection only.

Scope: EWS XML response deserialization.
